name: How Much Does a Garage Addition Cost in Los Angeles County?

mainEntity.name: How much does a garage addition contractor cost in Los Angeles County for a detached one-car garage versus a two-car garage?
mainEntity.text: How much does a garage addition contractor cost in Los Angeles County for a detached one-car garage versus a two-car garage?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost difference between a one-car and two-car garage addition is usually driven by square footage, but in Los Angeles County the budget can change quickly because labor, permits, and site conditions are often as important as size. A one-car garage may be simpler to frame and roof, but a two-car garage often requires a larger slab, more structural material, upgraded electrical, and sometimes higher permitting and design fees. Detached garages also tend to cost more per square foot if the site needs utility trenching, driveway changes, or fire-rated wall detailing near property lines. Homeowners should ask for a line-item estimate that separates foundation, framing, roofing, electrical, doors, finishes, and permit costs so they can compare bids fairly. If the goal is future living space or an ADU, the contractor should also price in insulation, ventilation, and code-related upgrades from the start.
acceptedAnswer.description: In Los Angeles County, a detached garage addition can vary widely by size, foundation work, finishes, and permitting. A one-car garage is usually much less expensive than a two-car garage because it needs less square footage, framing, roofing, and electrical work. Site access, soil conditions, and design complexity can also raise the total.
